unknown_contract_items.issue: Per-frame records have no schema_version; the records file name, location and format (JSONL vs array) are not defined.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Add schema_version `q-demo.detection-record.v1` and state the file format.

unknown_contract_items.issue: The manifest's class_map has only version and hash; the label list that Q1 support depends on is stored nowhere, and class_alias.json has no schema.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Define class_map.labels (or a class_map file schema) and a q-demo.class-alias.v1 schema.
unknown_contract_items.affects: Q1_SUPPORTED_SET_CONSISTENCY (kit uses its own supported-classes input)

unknown_contract_items.issue: CLOCK_MAPPING_MISSING and TIME_EXPRESSION_INVALID are named as returns, but Q1/Q2 `status` lists do not contain them, and error responses (FORBIDDEN_INFERENCE_INPUT 422 etc.) have no body schema.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Say whether these are statuses or error codes and define the error-response body.

unknown_contract_items.issue: No HTTP endpoints or paths are defined for Q1, Q3 parse, Q2 or the Agent tools.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Add an endpoint table (method, path, request and response schema_version).
unknown_contract_items.affects: --base-url mode needs an --endpoint-map supplied by Codex

unknown_contract_items.issue: transition_candidates output has no schema: wrapper fields, ranking_basis shape, the name of the truncated-count field, the shape of window_truncated_us (§8.6) and the schema_version are not defined. (The hash rule is now defined: §2.2, candidate_snapshot_sha256.)
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Define q-demo.candidate-snapshot.v1 (wrapper, truncated count, window_truncated_us as a list of half-open ranges).

unknown_contract_items.issue: Relationship between candidate_set_complete, truncated and a top_k cut is not stated (v1.1 §6.1 defines truncated as budget-only).
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: State whether a top_k cut sets truncated or candidate_set_complete=false.

unknown_contract_items.issue: traversability lists two values but §1 says unapproved passability is UNKNOWN; relation lists OVERLAP/BLIND_GAP but tier 4 (coverage / visible range / exit data missing) has no field to mark it; a BLIND_GAP whose path is neither all-OPEN APPROVED_WALKABLE nor has an UNKNOWN edge has no tier in §5.4; BIDIRECTIONAL/ADJACENT boundary-ref field names are not given.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Add UNKNOWN to both closed lists (kit accepts it, and reads relation UNKNOWN as tier 4), define the tier of the remaining combination and name the ADJACENT boundary ref field.

unknown_contract_items.issue: `parsed_by` values other than LLM, the `parser_mode` enum, the clarification/options shape, and where the rule parser's version and hash live in provenance are not defined.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Define parsed_by (LLM|RULE), parser_mode enum and provenance.rule_parser {version, sha256}.

unknown_contract_items.issue: The LLM explanation has no output schema, endpoint or schema_version; how its `content_sha256` is computed is not stated.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Define q-demo.explanation.v1 {explains_output_sha256, text, cited_refs, fallback_reason, content_sha256}.

unknown_contract_items.issue: Link records are now fully listed (prev_observation_id, next_observation_id, iou, elapsed_us, gap_samples, decision, §8.2) but have no schema_version, file name or location, no session binding, and the contract does not say what next_observation_id / iou hold for a non-LINKED decision.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Define q-demo.link-record.v1, the file (kit convention: <stem>.links.jsonl next to the decisions file) and the values of next_observation_id / iou when nothing is linked.
unknown_contract_items.affects: LINK_RECORD_GAP_RULES, SEARCHING_TRIGGER_TIME (kit uses a PROVISIONAL schema and the link file convention)

unknown_contract_items.issue: `budget_used_ms` sits inside the hashed body of decision-record, but §8.7 requires RULE_ONLY replays to have identical content_sha256; a measured value would break that.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Move budget_used_ms under stats, or fix it to 0 for RULE_ONLY.

unknown_contract_items.issue: decisions_sha256 (Q2 response) has no definition (file hash or content hash, ordering); decision-record `rounds_used` does not say whether it is per decision or per SEARCHING episode; 'last switching decision' for decision_source does not say whether RETURN_TO_ORIGIN counts. (agent_used is defined since 1d1e061: an accepted AGENT step.)
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: State each rule; the kit treats SWITCH and RETURN_TO_ORIGIN as switching decisions and does not recompute decisions_sha256.

unknown_contract_items.issue: With MODE_NOT_AUTHORIZED the response is RULE_ONLY but fallback_used is true; it is not stated whether decision_source is RULE_ONLY or RULE_FALLBACK. (The ILLEGAL_CANDIDATE counter is per SEARCHING since 1d1e061.)
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: State decision_source for MODE_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
unknown_contract_items.affects: COMMON_AGENT_FIELDS, Q2_RESPONSE_VS_DECISIONS (kit accepts RULE_ONLY with fallback_used)

unknown_contract_items.issue: APPEARANCE seeds with several candidates need a user choice, but no response status or payload exists for 'awaiting seed selection'; NO_SEED does not say whether it may be returned when time coverage is partial.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Add a status (e.g. SEED_SELECTION_REQUIRED) and say whether NO_SEED needs coverage_complete.
unknown_contract_items.affects: Q2_TIMELINE_STRUCTURE (NO_SEED is not forced to coverage_complete)

unknown_contract_items.issue: segment_merge_gap_us: whether the gap is measured between sample times or range ends, and strict vs inclusive, is not defined.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Define the gap operator.

unknown_contract_items.issue: query_id / query_sha256 / decision_id derivation from 'the normalised request' has no normalisation rule, so they cannot be recomputed.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Specify the normalised-request canonical form.

unknown_contract_items.issue: parameter-set.v1 is defined (§11) but several §11 parameters have no machine name (crop ratio, HSV bands, exit rule, ...), the unit vocabulary is open, and the values of approval.status other than PROPOSED / APPROVED are not listed.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Name every parameter and list the approval.status values.
unknown_contract_items.affects: kit reads parameters[] by name; approval.status is kept a free string

unknown_contract_items.issue: unknown_reason is one field per detection but verdicts are per colour; whether all verdicts must be UNKNOWN when it is set is not stated.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: State the relation.

unknown_contract_items.issue: Multi-run queries carry a single `clock_mapping_sha256` in resolved_scope although each run has its own mapping (§3.1 says each run uses its own mapping and no person may be chained across runs).
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Make it a map run_id -> sha256 or a hash over the set.

unknown_contract_items.issue: step_index counts steps, but only decisions are in the decisions file (link / TEMP_LOST steps are not), so records are not state-contiguous and step_index is not guaranteed consecutive.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: State whether the decisions file includes every step; the kit checks only that step_index increases and time never goes backwards.

unknown_contract_items.issue: PARAMETER_GRID_MISMATCH is 'returned' but the form is not defined: error code (HTTP status?), response status or reason. The same holds for PARAMETERS_NOT_APPROVED (reason, §11).
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: State how PARAMETER_GRID_MISMATCH is returned, with its HTTP status.
unknown_contract_items.affects: Q2_FAIL_CLOSED_ON_GRID_MISMATCH (kit expects an error_response with error_code PARAMETER_GRID_MISMATCH for a Q2 request)

unknown_contract_items.issue: The evidence summary has no schema_version or endpoint, and the preimage of evidence_sha256 is not stated (only that documents citing ids hash them as strings). The summary also does not say how a colour-less query is recorded (color_verdict) and whether the window_us shown is the clipped one.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Define q-demo.candidate-evidence.v1 and the evidence_sha256 preimage.
unknown_contract_items.affects: EVIDENCE_PRESENCE_RULES, DECISION_EVIDENCE_AND_ENTRY (PROVISIONAL schema; evidence_sha256 only used as a link value)

unknown_contract_items.issue: session_max_research_rounds, session_max_agent_rounds and fallback_budget_ms cannot be verified from the recorded artifacts: the decisions file does not state the number of SEARCHING episodes, `rounds_used` is of unknown scope (U13) and no field records the fallback's wall-clock use.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: Record episode counters and fallback wall-clock use in the decision record (or its stats).

unknown_contract_items.issue: The manifest has a top-level sampling.stride_samples and a stride_samples per camera (§4.4); their relation is not stated.
unknown_contract_items.suggestion: State whether they must be equal or the top-level value is only a default.
unknown_contract_items.affects: INDEX_MANIFEST_RULES (checks only index_interval_us = per-camera stride x source interval)

resolved_contract_items.was: observation_id hash segment vs records_file_sha256 cycle
resolved_contract_items.resolved_by: §2.2 detection index: index_id / observation_id use the index key (manifest without index_id, content_sha256, records_ref, records_file_sha256); content_sha256 keeps records_file_sha256
§2.2 candidate snapshot: preimage without candidate_snapshot_sha256 and every candidate_ref
§2.2 general documents: preimage without content_sha256 and the document's own id field (graph_id, parameter_set_id)
